indexMeaning: Zero-based order among non-declaration, non-import module statements. Inclusive ranges cover all 359 statements.

categories.rule: Rules execution needs the side effect or an explicitly invoked entry point.
categories.dependency: Rule code references this data or entry point, but the top-level side effect is not needed for the supported local path.
categories.observation: Player-visible label, card text, or help metadata.
categories.ui: DOM, animation, input wiring, sound, diagnostics, or browser startup.
categories.network: Online play, account, route, storage, or record integration.
categories.uncertain: Rule relevance requires further execution evidence.

explicitEntryPoints.331: resetGame(false, []) is invoked after local mode selection; module startup is suppressed.

reviewNotes: Indices 2-98 and 100-118 are authority/catalog validations or immutable metadata construction. Source declarations retain their values; the local oracle does not execute those top-level checks as a substitute for the source SHA and catalog assertions.
Index 109 registers an AI worker. Its influence on local action ordering is unresolved; exhaustive local legality must not claim coverage from this profile.
Indices 127-168 populate TYPE_LABELS used by source messages and player-visible labels.
Indices 171-194 mutate card categories, definitions, aliases, stars, targets, and help. They execute in source order before a new game.
Index 331 is the browser's startup reset. The headless profile invokes the same source function at a controlled initialization boundary.
Indices 203-319 bind browser input or online callbacks. Their callbacks are not a rules execution path in the local VM; the source functions they call remain available from declarations.
VM context and frozen source digest limit accidental execution drift. Node vm is not a security boundary for hostile code.
